newsitem.title: UK: Key Eurotunnel banks to meet Friday - paper.
newsitem.headline: Key Eurotunnel banks to meet Friday - paper.

text.p: A meeting of the key 26 bank lenders to Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel will be held on Friday to consider the latest proposals in the search for a solution to the company's debt mountain, the Times said in its Monday edition.
The paper said the meeting would be the first after the ending of a mandate for two mediators, Robert Badinter and Lord Wakeham, who were appointed by a French court.
A source close to the negotiations told Reuters last week that it was unlikely Eurotunnel would ask for an extension of the mandate, which ends on Monday.
Eurotunnel is attempting to restructure more than 8.0 billion stg of junior bank debt with 225 banks.
The Times said the meeting on Friday would consider proposals which are thought to include a 49 percent debt-for-equity swap and exchanging 2.0 billion stg of debt for convertible securities.
The pricing of these instruments is widely reported to be the major sticking point in the negotiations.
Eurotunnel froze interest payments on its huge debts in September 1995.
